description: Source code for managing repair orders in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including classes for repair orders, repair lines, fees, and related methods.

classes.name: mrp_repair
classes.description: Model for managing repair orders, including creation, confirmation, invoicing, and completion.

classes.name: mrp_repair_line
classes.description: Model for individual repair operation lines, including product details, pricing, and invoicing status.

classes.name: mrp_repair_fee
classes.description: Model for additional repair fees, including invoicing and tax details.

classes.name: ProductChangeMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing product change logic, such as price and tax calculation.

methods.name: _amount_untaxed
methods.description: Calculates untaxed amount for repair order.

methods.name: _amount_tax
methods.description: Calculates tax amount for repair order.

methods.name: _amount_total
methods.description: Calculates total amount (untaxed + tax) for repair order.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a repair order with default values.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Handles product selection change, updating related fields.

methods.name: onchange_move_id
methods.description: Updates guarantee limit and locations based on selected stock move.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Placeholder method for button actions.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates address and pricelist based on selected partner.

methods.name: onchange_lot_id
methods.description: Updates move and location info based on selected lot.

methods.name: action_cancel_draft
methods.description: Resets repair order to draft state.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the repair order, changing state accordingly.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the repair order.

methods.name: wkf_invoice_create
methods.description: Workflow method to create invoice.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoice(s) for the repair order, including invoice lines for operations and fees.

methods.name: action_repair_ready
methods.description: Marks repair as ready.

methods.name: action_invoice_cancel
methods.description: Marks invoice as exception.

methods.name: action_repair_start
methods.description: Marks repair as under repair.

methods.name: action_invoice_end
methods.description: Marks invoice as completed.

methods.name: action_repair_end
methods.description: Marks repair as completed and possibly invoiced.

methods.name: wkf_repair_done
methods.description: Workflow method to finalize repair.

methods.name: action_repair_done
methods.description: Completes repair, creates stock moves, and handles delivery if needed.
